verdict.rationale: Firebase documents a first-party Local Emulator Suite for building and testing locally across Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and Extensions. Apps connect directly to these emulators for integration testing without touching production, the Test SDK supports unit tests against them, and the CLI runs a local Hosting server. missing for 10: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulation are still beta, coverage of other backend products (e.g., SQL Connect) is not evidenced, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the local workflow.
